name: africa-book
description: Landing page and mdBook edition for Exploration and Exploitation of Petroleum Resources in West Africa.

scripts.build: npm run build:index && npm run build:legal && mdbook build && npm run build:chapters
scripts.check:docx-parity: python3 scripts/check_docx_parity.py --docx "resources/Exploration and Exploitation of Petroleum Resources in West Africa (Matt Edited).docx" --summary src/SUMMARY.md --chapters-dir src/chapters
scripts.check:docx-figures: python3 scripts/check_docx_figures.py --docx "resources/Exploration and Exploitation of Petroleum Resources in West Africa (Matt Edited).docx" --summary src/SUMMARY.md --chapters-dir src/chapters --manifest src/images/figure-manifest.json
scripts.build:site: rm -rf public && mkdir -p public && npm run build:index && npm run build:legal && npm run build:chapters && cp index.html public/index.html && cp terms-of-use.html public/terms-of-use.html && cp privacy-policy.html public/privacy-policy.html && cp cookie-policy.html public/cookie-policy.html && cp -R assets public/assets && cp -R chapters public/chapters && mdbook build --dest-dir public/book && npm run build:reader-meta
